examples.en: Dad is good at cooking, and he likes to prepare dinner for us.
examples.zh: 父親精通廚藝，他喜歡為我們準備晚餐。

examples.en: Students need to prepare thoroughly for their final examinations.
examples.zh: 學生們需要為期末考做好充分準備。

examples.en: The chef spent hours preparing fresh seasonal ingredients for the banquet.
examples.zh: 主廚花了數小時為宴會準備新鮮的當季食材。

examples.en: It is essential to prepare a clear and structured presentation before meeting the client.
examples.zh: 在與客戶會面前，準備一份清晰且有條理的簡報至關重要。

examples.en: Financial institutions must proactively prepare contingency protocols to withstand economic volatility.
examples.zh: 金融機構必須積極準備應變方案以抵禦經濟波動。

examples.en: Lucy always takes price into consideration when she buys new dresses.
examples.zh: Lucy 買新洋裝時總是會把價錢列入考慮。

examples.en: Thank you very much for your kind consideration of my application.
examples.zh: 非常感謝您對我申請的貼心考量。

examples.en: Environmental impact was a primary consideration during the construction planning phase.
examples.zh: 環境影響是施工規劃階段的主要考量。

examples.en: The committee submitted the proposal to the board of directors for further consideration.
examples.zh: 委員會將該提案呈交董事會作進一步考慮。

examples.en: Equitable stakeholder distribution demands serious ethical consideration from corporate executives.
examples.zh: 公平的利害關係人分配需要企業高階主管進行嚴肅的倫理考量。

examples.en: All the guests at Jessica and Brian's wedding were happy and excited.
examples.zh: 在 Jessica 與 Brian 婚禮上的所有賓客既高興又興奮。

examples.en: We invited several guests over to our house for Sunday dinner.
examples.zh: 我們邀請了幾位客人週日來家裡吃晚餐。

examples.en: The luxury resort provided exceptional personalized services to ensure guest satisfaction.
examples.zh: 這座豪華度假村提供卓越的個人化服務以確保房客滿意。

examples.en: Distinguished guest speakers shared their valuable industry experiences at the international forum.
examples.zh: 尊貴的演講嘉賓在國際論壇上分享了他們寶貴的行業經驗。

examples.en: Hospitality management continuously evaluates guest feedback metrics to refine operational excellence.
examples.zh: 餐旅管理持續評估住客回饋指標以提升營運卓越性。

examples.en: After dinner, the host asked one of his guests to play the piano.
examples.zh: 晚餐後，主人請求其中一位來賓演奏鋼琴。

examples.en: Everybody here hopes our city will host the Summer Olympics someday.
examples.zh: 這裡的每個人都希望我們的城市將來有一天能主辦夏季奧運。

examples.en: She served as an engaging and gracious host throughout the annual award gala.
examples.zh: 在整個年度頒獎典禮上，她擔任了富有魅力且優雅的主持人。

examples.en: Taiwan will host a prestigious global semiconductor exhibition later this year.
examples.zh: 台灣將於今年稍晚主辦一場極具聲望的全球半導體展覽。

examples.en: Successfully hosting international diplomatic summits requires flawless logistical synchronization.
examples.zh: 成功主辦國際外交峰會需要無瑕的後勤協同能力。

examples.en: Our trip to Canada was pleasant. I'll remember it for the rest of my life.
examples.zh: 我們的加拿大之旅非常愉快。我這輩子都會記得它。

examples.en: We had a pleasant afternoon chatting in the botanical garden.
examples.zh: 我們在植物園度過了一個愉快的聊天午後。

examples.en: The receptionist greeted every visitor with a pleasant and warm smile.
examples.zh: 接待員帶著和藹溫暖的微笑迎接每位訪客。

examples.en: Working in such a pleasant office atmosphere greatly improves employee morale.
examples.zh: 在如此令人愉悅的辦公室氛圍中工作極大地提升了員工士氣。

examples.en: Cultivating pleasant ergonomic workplaces mitigates occupational stress and fosters productivity.
examples.zh: 營造愉悅的人體工學職場能減輕職業壓力並提升生產力。

examples.en: The superstar didn't want to answer the reporter's awkward questions about her personal life.
examples.zh: 這名超級巨星不想回答記者提出關於她私生活的尷尬問題。

examples.en: There was an awkward silence after he told a joke that nobody understood.
examples.zh: 在他講了一個沒人聽懂的笑話後，現場陷入一陣尷尬的沉默。

examples.en: She felt awkward attending the formal dinner without knowing anyone there.
examples.zh: 在不認識任何人的情況下參加正式晚宴讓她覺得很不自在。

examples.en: He made an awkward gesture that revealed his nervousness during the interview.
examples.zh: 他在面試中做出了一個尷尬的動作，暴露出他的緊張。

examples.en: Diplomats skillfully navigated awkward political tensions to achieve a consensus.
examples.zh: 外交官巧妙地化解了尷尬棘手的政治緊張關係以達成共識。

examples.en: Sue has a good voice and enjoys singing; therefore, she plans to be a singer.
examples.zh: Sue 有一副好歌喉而且喜歡唱歌；因此，她打算以後要當歌手。

examples.en: The heavy rain caused flooding; therefore, morning classes were canceled.
examples.zh: 大雨引發淹水；因此，早上的課程取消了。

examples.en: He failed to submit the required forms in time and was therefore disqualified.
examples.zh: 他未能及時繳交所需表格，因此被取消了資格。

examples.en: Market demand shifted toward mobile devices; therefore, the firm adjusted its production lines.
examples.zh: 市場需求轉向行動裝置；因此，該公司調整了生產線。

examples.en: Operating expenses consistently exceeded projections; therefore, restructuring became imperative.
examples.zh: 營運支出持續超出預期；因此，組織重組勢在必行。

examples.en: Dad usually assigns us to clean the living room and bedrooms on Sundays.
examples.zh: 爸爸星期天通常會指派我們整理客廳及臥室。

examples.en: Our English teacher will assign new homework at the end of every class.
examples.zh: 我們的英文老師每堂課結束時都會指派新作業。

examples.en: The manager assigned specific project roles to each member based on their expertise.
examples.zh: 經理根據每位成員的專業指派了具體的專案角色。

examples.en: Senior developers were assigned to investigate and resolve the critical database failure.
examples.zh: 資深開發人員被指派調查並解決關鍵的資料庫故障。

examples.en: Automated algorithms dynamically assign server bandwidth to ensure optimal network performance.
examples.zh: 自動化演算法動態分配伺服器頻寬以確保最佳網路效能。

examples.en: Linda is originally from America, but now she lives in South Korea with her husband.
examples.zh: Linda 原先來自美國，但她現在跟她先生住在南韓。

examples.en: The conference was originally planned for next month, but it got postponed.
examples.zh: 該會議原定於下個月舉行，但被延期了。

examples.en: This historic downtown library was originally founded as a private reading club.
examples.zh: 這座位於市中心的歷史圖書館起初是作為私人讀書俱樂部建立的。

examples.en: He originally considered studying medicine before choosing computer software engineering.
examples.zh: 在選擇電腦軟體工程之前，他原先曾考慮就讀醫學。

examples.en: The complex architectural structure was originally conceptualized as an eco-friendly community hub.
examples.zh: 這棟複雜的建築結構最初被構想為一個環保社區核心樞紐。

examples.en: The kids were surprised by their grandparents' unexpected visit.
examples.zh: 孩子們對於他們祖父母出乎意料的拜訪感到驚訝。

examples.en: We received an unexpected gift from a neighbor yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 我們昨天早上收到了來自鄰居的意外禮物。

examples.en: An unexpected server crash disrupted online customer services for three hours.
examples.zh: 突如其來的伺服器當機導致線上客戶服務中斷了三個小時。

examples.en: The financial report showed unexpected quarterly profits despite severe market inflation.
examples.zh: 儘管面臨嚴重的市場通膨，財報仍顯示了出乎意料的季度獲利。

examples.en: Mitigating unexpected disruptions requires resilient logistics and thorough contingency planning.
examples.zh: 減緩突發性干擾需要具備彈性的物流架構及周密的應變規劃。

examples.en: We went to a book fair yesterday and bought some comic books.
examples.zh: 我們昨天去書展，買了一些漫畫書。

examples.en: The annual science fair gives high school students a chance to showcase inventions.
examples.zh: 年度科學博覽會給予高中生展示發明的機會。

examples.en: Local farmers set up booths at the weekend agricultural fair to sell fresh produce.
examples.zh: 當地農民在週末農產市集擺攤銷售新鮮農產品。

examples.en: The international trade fair attracted thousands of prospective industrial investors.
examples.zh: 這場國際貿易展覽會吸引了數千名潛在的工業投資者。

examples.en: Industry trade fairs serve as catalytic platforms for cross-border commercial partnerships.
examples.zh: 產業商展是促進跨國商業合作夥伴關係的重要平台。

examples.en: The delicious foods in the night markets of Taiwan impress many people from other countries.
examples.zh: 臺灣夜市的美食使許多外國人留下深刻的印象。

examples.en: Her brilliant piano performance managed to impress everyone in the audience.
examples.zh: 她精湛的鋼琴演奏成功讓台下的每個人留下深刻印象。

examples.en: The candidate's extensive knowledge of cybersecurity impressed the hiring managers.
examples.zh: 應徵者在網路安全方面的豐富知識給招聘經理留下了深刻印象。

examples.en: The ancient architecture and grand historical landmarks never fail to impress tourists.
examples.zh: 古老的建築與宏偉的歷史名勝總是能讓遊客印象深刻。

examples.en: Consistently delivering innovative solutions is essential to impress discerning global clients.
examples.zh: 持續交付創新解決方案是給眼光獨到的全球客戶留下深刻印象的關鍵。

examples.en: Tim has a secret hiding place for his favorite toys, so his baby brother can't take them.
examples.zh: Tim 有一個藏他最愛玩具的秘密地點，所以他的弟弟不會拿走它們。

examples.en: They planned a secret birthday party for their classmate without telling her.
examples.zh: 他們瞞著同學為她籌劃了一場秘密生日派對。

examples.en: The grandmother kept her special pie recipe a closely guarded family secret.
examples.zh: 祖母將她的獨門派餅食譜列為嚴密保守的家族秘密。

examples.en: Detectives uncovered a secret underground operation involved in illegal smuggling.
examples.zh: 偵探們破獲了一個涉及非法走私的地下秘密組織。

examples.en: Safeguarding corporate trade secrets is paramount to sustaining competitive advantage.
examples.zh: 嚴格保護企業商業機密對於維持競爭優勢至關重要。

examples.en: My family went to Kenting and had an enjoyable holiday.
examples.zh: 我們全家去墾丁並且度過了一個愉快的假期。

examples.en: Listening to acoustic music while cooking is a very enjoyable hobby.
examples.zh: 邊做飯邊聽原聲音樂是一項令人非常愉悅的嗜好。

examples.en: The friendly workshop environment made learning programming enjoyable and accessible.
examples.zh: 工作坊友善的環境讓程式學習變得生動有趣且易於理解。

examples.en: We spent an enjoyable evening catching up with college friends at a cozy café.
examples.zh: 我們在一家溫馨的咖啡館與大學好友相聚，度過了一個愉快的夜晚。

examples.en: Cultivating an intellectually enjoyable workplace stimulates cross-disciplinary innovation.
examples.zh: 營造一個在知性上令人愉悅的工作場所能激發跨領域的創新活力。

examples.en: Jenny had many interesting experiences during her summer camp in New York City.
examples.zh: 在紐約市參加夏令營期間，Jenny 獲得了許多有趣的經驗。

examples.en: Traveling independently across Europe gave him great life experience.
examples.zh: 獨自橫跨歐洲旅行帶給他豐富的人生經歷。

examples.en: Applicants with prior customer service experience will be given priority in the interview.
examples.zh: 具備客服經驗的應徵者將在面試中獲得優先考量。

examples.en: She learned valuable leadership lessons through her volunteer management experience.
examples.zh: 她透過志工管理經驗學到了寶貴的領導課。

examples.en: Synthesizing theoretical knowledge with practical operational experience fosters strategic maturity.
examples.zh: 將理論知識與實際營運經驗相結合有助於促進策略成熟度。

examples.en: Lily's 16th birthday is coming, and she plans to invite some friends over for a party.
examples.zh: Lily 的 16 歲生日快到了，她計畫邀請一些好友到家裡聚會。

examples.en: Let's invite the new neighbors over for coffee this Saturday.
examples.zh: 這個星期六我們邀請新鄰居來家裡喝杯咖啡吧。

examples.en: My parents like to invite their childhood friends over whenever the holidays arrive.
examples.zh: 每逢節假日，我父母總喜歡邀請兒時玩伴到家裡作客。

examples.en: We invited our study group over to work on the final history presentation together.
examples.zh: 我們邀請學習小組成員來家裡一起準備歷史期末簡報。

examples.en: Executives frequently invite key partners over for informal dinners to cement partnerships.
examples.zh: 高階主管常邀請重要合作夥伴到府進行非正式晚宴以鞏固夥伴關係。

examples.en: Jessica is trying to come up with some ideas for a Mother's Day gift for her mom.
examples.zh: Jessica 正設法想出一些給媽媽母親節禮物的點子。

examples.en: He couldn't come up with an answer to the teacher's question.
examples.zh: 他回答不出老師提出的問題。

examples.en: The engineering team needs to come up with an efficient solution to reduce server latency.
examples.zh: 工程團隊需要想出一個有效的解決方案來降低伺服器延遲。

examples.en: During the brainstorming session, marketing staff came up with multiple viral advertising ideas.
examples.zh: 在腦力激盪會議中，行銷人員想出了多個具病毒式傳播效應的廣告創意。

examples.en: Innovative enterprises must continually come up with proprietary technologies to dominate competitive markets.
examples.zh: 創新企業必須不斷研發專有技術以在競爭激烈的市場中佔據主導地位。

examples.en: Many people think that money is everything, but in fact, the most important thing for us is our health.
examples.zh: 很多人認為金錢是萬能的，但事實上，對我們最重要的東西是健康。

examples.en: He looks very young, but in fact, he has already worked for ten years.
examples.zh: 他看起來很年輕，但事實上他已經工作十年了。

examples.en: The problem seemed simple at first; in fact, it required an overhaul of the entire codebase.
examples.zh: 這個問題起初看起來很簡單；事實上，它需要對整個代碼庫進行全面翻修。

examples.en: She claimed she was not hungry; in fact, she had skipped breakfast and lunch altogether.
examples.zh: 她聲稱自己不餓；實際上，她連早餐和午餐都完全沒吃。

examples.en: Macroeconomic figures appeared stable on the surface; in fact, underlying liquidity risks were mounting.
examples.zh: 總體經濟數據表面看似穩定；然而事實上，潛在的流動性風險正在累積。

examples.en: The "Rockies" refers to a famous mountain range in North America.
examples.zh: 「落磯山脈」是指北美洲一座著名的山脈。

examples.en: Students may refer to their textbooks during the open-book quiz.
examples.zh: 學生在開卷測驗期間可以參考他們的課本。

examples.en: In technical manuals, the abbreviation "API" refers to Application Programming Interface.
examples.zh: 在技術手冊中，縮寫「API」指的是應用程式介面。

examples.en: When discussing corporate ethics, she often referred to international sustainability benchmarks.
examples.zh: 在討論企業倫理時，她經常引用國際永續指標作為參考。

examples.en: Legal scholars frequently refer to historic precedent when interpreting constitutional amendments.
examples.zh: 法學專家在詮釋憲法修正案時，經常參考具有里程碑意義的歷史判例。

examples.en: The church in the city dates back to the late 1800s.
examples.zh: 在這座城市裡的那座教堂追溯到 19 世紀末。

examples.en: These traditional festival celebrations date back over two centuries.
examples.zh: 這些傳統節慶慶祝活動可以追溯到兩個多世紀以前。

examples.en: Archaeologists discovered ancient ceramic fragments dating back to the Neolithic era.
examples.zh: 考古學家發現了可追溯至新石器時代的古代陶器碎片。

examples.en: The diplomatic alliance between the two coastal nations dates back to the mid-twentieth century.
examples.zh: 這兩個沿海國家之間的外交同盟可以追溯到二十世紀中葉。

examples.en: Archival manuscripts confirm that the customary legal doctrine dates back to medieval jurisprudence.
examples.zh: 檔案手稿證實該習慣法學說可追溯至中世紀的法理學體系。

examples.en: When the superstar showed up, all the fans were very excited and began to shout loudly.
examples.zh: 當那名超級巨星出現時，所有粉絲興奮不已，開始大聲尖叫。

examples.en: He promised to attend the morning meeting, but he didn't show up on time.
examples.zh: 他答應參加晨會，但他沒有準時出現。

examples.en: Hundreds of eager applicants showed up for the walk-in interviews on Monday.
examples.zh: 數百名熱切的求職者週一出現在現場面試會場。

examples.en: Unexpected system flaws started to show up after the software was deployed globally.
examples.zh: 軟體在全球部署後，意想不到的系統缺陷開始顯現出來。

examples.en: Strategic vulnerabilities invariably show up when organizations encounter severe external macroeconomic stress.
examples.zh: 當企業面臨嚴峻的外部總體經濟壓力時，其策略脆弱點總是會無所遁形。
